dogecoin.text:
📌 On 8 Oct 2021 Dogecoin gained a market valuation of $31.9 billion dollars higher than last year valuation of $339 million dollars 

📍 Some facts:-

- By its first birthday, Dogecoin had a market capitalization of $20 million and a loyal fanbase.

📌 In 2019 Dogecoin saw another bump in value

- Dogecoin traders were very happy when the Binance exchange-listed this coin and also Elon Musk started tweeting about Dogecoin

- Elon Musk had also ran a poll that if they should accept Dogecoin as a form of Payment in Tesla

📍 Billy Markus a software developer and Palmer made the actual software behind Dogecoin

- Dogecoin uses Litecoin's scrypt technology and it is a PoW coin

- It was launched on 13 Dec 2013, 2 weeks later the value of Dogecoin jumped to 300%

📌 How it started ?

- Jackson Palmer a product manager in Sydney, Australia created Dogecoin in 2013

- After getting positive feedback from people he bought the domain
 https://t.co/vRpaxtdW89

📌 Introduction to Dogecoin 

Dogecoin is also a legit P2P cryptocurrency like Bitcoin or Ethereum

It was started as a meme, but gained popularity in 2017. It is mainly used for tipping on Reddit and Twitter. Many people buy and trade Dogecoin too

📍 So let's see how it started
